Writing room and 14 months are there, but photo 2 is not a 1.5x close-up: crop is 70.5% of page width (722 px) in a 1750 px frame = 2.42 photo px per page px; the full 2700 px photo on the same screen shows the page at about 0.92x its on-screen size (only 1.42x even against a whole page in the same frame). For about 1.5x: about 2400 px frame with crop x 0.015-0.62, or crop to about 44% of the page width.
Paper is (27,31,43) = #1B1F2B, ink (246,243,251), contrast 14.98:1, amber accents; Start here step 3 says to pick white, pale gray or a light pen color.

Navy paper, light ink, amber accents, landscape; Baskerville headings and italic labels, Outfit body, no tracked caps; tabs 7.3-7.8:1, 2027 tiles about 8.8-9:1, dimmed outside-month dates 3.72:1, as specified.

visual.issue: Head start trail label is wrong for October dates: the day pages for Oct 26 to 31 and week 1 read 'November 2026 / Oct 26 to Nov 1', although those days are in October. Rule r008 says day pages name their own month, and the 2027 pages do this (d0101 reads 'January / Dec 28 to Jan 3'). An Oct 26-31 buyer meets this label on day one. No tab is highlighted on these six day pages either.
Photo 2 is not the promised 1.5x close-up of the day page. Viewed on the same screen it shows the page at about 0.92x its on-screen size (2.42 photo px per page px vs 2.64 for a full-width page).

Rail link rects are not strictly inside the page box: on all 533 pages the top 2026 tab link runs to y=576.06 pt on a 576 pt page (0.06 pt over). The Jun and Jul tab links also overlap by 0.75 pt. A buyer cannot see this, but it is outside the box.

Ruled lines are hairlines at sub-pixel width, so their weight changes from page to page. Tomorrow lines vanish at 1x (96 dpi) on 214 of 432 day pages, and Wins/Next week lines vanish on 32 of 62 week pages; at 2x they draw at 1 px on those pages and 2 px on the others.

Photo 4's small text: date digits about 17 px and the 'Week 1-4' buttons about 13 px cap height on a 2700 px photo. They are readable at Etsy full-screen zoom but tiny in the gallery. The frame fills only the middle third of the photo, and the top third is empty.

On head start pages the Jan-Oct tabs are 2027 months with no year, next to 'Nov 2026'/'Dec 2026'. A late-October buyer tapping 'Oct' gets October 2027. Nov and Dec 2027 cannot be reached by tab from these pages.
